name: alert
title: Alert
description: A versatile alert component with multiple variants (filled, light, lighter, stroke), status colors (error, warning, success, information, feature), and sizes. Uses namespace exports: Alert.Root, Alert.Icon, Alert.CloseIcon.

migration.guide: API changed: import as namespace `import * as Alert from ...`, use `<Alert.Root variant="filled" status="error">` instead of `<Alert variant="errorFilled">`. Variant and status are now separate props. Sub-components: `Alert.Icon` (polymorphic), `Alert.CloseIcon`. Old `AlertTitle`, `AlertDescription`, `AlertActions`, `AlertLink`, `AlertButton` sub-components removed. Dependencies changed from `cva` + `react-icons` to `tv` + `@remixicon/react`. Old `alert-utils.ts` is no longer included.

docs.lead: A versatile alert component with multiple variants, status colors, and sizes for user notifications.
docs.usage:
import * as Alert from "@/components/ui/alert"

<Alert.Root variant="filled" status="error">
  <Alert.Icon as={RiErrorWarningFill} />
  Insert your alert title here!
</Alert.Root>
